selection_reasoning: These tasks form a natural dependency chain where a brown mushroom is hidden behind or enclosed within jungle leaves. The agent must first mine through the jungle leaves to clear the path and reveal the brown mushroom. This creates a meaningful multi-hop structure: the physical obstruction (jungle leaves) must be removed before the target (brown mushroom) can be found/observed. Both tasks are observable, verifiable, and don't require deep Minecraft expertise — just breaking blocks and navigating to a target.

edges.reason: Brown mushroom is enclosed behind jungle leaves; mining the leaves clears the obstruction so the mushroom becomes visible and accessible

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because when jungle leaves are mined with shears (which the player is given), the leaf block drops as an item and enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no jungle_leaves in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms they mined a leaf block. Shears are the tool that causes leaves to drop as items rather than nothing.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate close to the brown mushroom (hidden inside the leaf enclosure at spawn-relative [6,1,6]) and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. max_distance=4.0 ensures the player must be inside or at the opening of the breached structure (spawn is ~8.5 blocks away, so this cannot be trivially satisfied). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the mushroom.

scene_description: A sealed 5x4x5 cube of jungle leaves sits on a podzol platform approximately 6 blocks from the player spawn. Inside the cube is a 3x2x3 hollow chamber containing a single brown mushroom on podzol at the center (relative coordinates ~6 ~1 ~6). The player spawns with shears and must mine through the jungle leaves to breach the enclosure, then locate the brown mushroom hidden inside. Jungle leaves use persistent=true to prevent natural decay. Podzol is used as the floor to ensure the mushroom persists regardless of light level changes when leaves are broken.
task_text: There is a cube structure made of jungle leaves nearby. Mine through the jungle leaves to find the brown mushroom hidden inside.
design_notes: Coordinates: Outer shell spans ~4,~0,~4 to ~8,~3,~8. Inner hollow spans ~5,~1,~5 to ~7,~2,~7. Brown mushroom at ~6,~1,~6 on podzol. Player spawns at ~0,~0,~0. Structure is ~6 blocks from spawn — visible but opaque. persistent=true prevents leaf decay without nearby logs. Podzol supports mushroom at any light level. Shears given for efficient leaf breaking (leaves also breakable by hand).
